experience.description: AI-powered helpdesk for B2B companies: an AI agent that answers their customers on WhatsApp, web chat and email, with a shared inbox and help center. In production with paying customers.
bullets: Led backend, AI and infrastructure end to end, from architecture to production operations, shipping 95+ releases since launch with a 4,600+ test suite.

Designed the evaluation pipeline behind every AI change, using LLM-as-judge scoring of real conversations, retrieval benchmarks and blind model comparisons to choose, tune and migrate models.
Implemented the Model Context Protocol on both sides: an MCP server with its own OAuth 2.1 authorization server and an MCP client that connects customers' own tools to the agent.
Developed the channel and business integrations as a separate service, including WhatsApp Business as a verified Meta Tech Provider, Slack, email, Shopify and HubSpot.

Provisioned the AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform and built the delivery pipeline (GitHub Actions CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, backups), with background jobs running on ArdiQ, a self-built Rust-core task queue.

Ran regular security audits and hardening across the platform, covering multi-tenant isolation, access control and auditing, container hardening, data scrubbing in observability and incident response.

projects.name: Zona 14
projects.description: AI-powered pre-match football analytics. Built a Dixon-Coles bivariate Poisson goal model, fit per league from football APIs (time-decay form weighting, shrinkage priors, xG targets and closing-odds signals; L-BFGS-B with analytic gradients) and backtested against sharp-bookmaker baselines via closing line value.
